dates_comment: proposed values of LIVE_TESTS_8.md 1.1; the window slides later with LT7's END_UTC (a move is recorded in the ledger); the module constants must equal these (L6)
k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gate passes (section 7), a subset of [CH203, CH202, CH204]; fixed at registration, never changed; a size-scenario failure sets only its own tests to p = 1 (1.8); provisional k <= 3
code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of live_tests8.py, live_tests8_analysis.py (phase 2), live_tests8_base.py, bounce_decomp.py and the hashed dependencies panel.py, trade_sample.py, cb17_census.py, cb13_label.py, economics.py, forecast.py (8.1)

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at k-1 and k; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order)

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: vendored-only: read by the copied category_cols; LT8 classifies crypto with crypto_classifier (the `crypto7` class), never with this rule

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug' (one family: one spot driver)

move.class_rule: never_traded (ltp absent at k-1 and k) > traded (L or V+) > ambiguous (V-, ltp present at k-1 and absent at k, or volume24hr unknown) > quote_only (not L, V0); geometry for every unit: parallel (sign db = sign da = sign x, both >= 0.005, |db - da| <= 0.005), one_sided (min(|db|,|da|) <= 0.0005), spread_change (opposite signs, both > 0.0005), same_side_unequal (rest) (LT3's, vendored)

crypto_classifier.rule: 1.0 / 1.4: every primary excludes crypto by this classifier; unknown (sidecar missing, field absent / empty / null-like) is counted separately and treated as crypto; the crypto arm is reported, uncounted
crypto_classifier.failsafe: if no distinct fee_category value of the whole sealed sidecar set contains 'crypto' the classifier is not shown to work and every census is refused as NaN (fails)

reward_rule.rule: NEW LT8 CODE (live_tests8.reward_status; unit tested; 1.0 (iv), 2): null / NaN / empty / whitespace-only / null-like text ('nan', 'none', 'null') is UNREWARDED (rate 0, rewarded 0); a valid JSON list of dict allocations parses to the summed rewardsDailyRate active on the capture's UTC day (an empty list is 0 = unrewarded); NON-NULL text that is not a JSON list of dicts, or an allocation with a non-numeric / negative / non-finite rate, is MALFORMED: excluded from the unit and counted (reward_malformed, split by reason json / not_list / alloc_not_dict / rate_bad), never 0; a sidecar without the clob_rewards COLUMN, or a market with no sidecar row, is NaN (no_column / no_sidecar), never unrewarded. AMENDED by LIVE_TESTS_8.md 13.7 (reward_null_rule listed_carry24h_v2): a null clob_rewards at origin k is rewarded = 1 when a LISTED text of the causal window [k - 11, k] re-parsed for day(k) gives a rate > 0 (latest such capture = the source; missing slots skipped and counted; no slot after k read); a carried unit takes rewards_max_spread (in_band) and rewards_min_size (ft_both) from the source capture; otherwise rewarded = 0 with the origin's parameters
reward_rule.in_band_rule: LT7 CH197's mechanical definition for EVERY market (LT7 13.6): folded mid in the reward band and sweep spread <= rewards_max_spread; NaN, excluded and counted, when rewards_max_spread is missing with the mid inside the band; rewarded x in_band is printed
reward_rule.ft_both_rule: rewarded and both bid_size_1 and ask_size_1 of sweep k - 1 <= 1.05 x rewards_min_size; 0 when unrewarded; NaN (excluded, counted) when rewarded and rewards_min_size or a size is missing
reward_rule.rw_changed_rule: AMENDED by LIVE_TESTS_8.md 13.7 (c): 1 if the effective text E(k) differs from E(k - 2), where E(s) is the capture's own non-null clob_rewards string at s, else (a null cell) the latest LISTED text of the slots [k - 11, s], else the empty string; NaN (excluded, counted) when capture k or k - 2 has no sidecar row for the market (unchanged); 13.7 ERRATUM: NaN, excluded and counted as rw_changed_no_column, when capture k or k - 2 is a sidecar without the clob_rewards column (an absent column is not an empty programme, check fix 7); the k-only v1 comparison is reported in a v1 x v2 table, descriptive only

reward_null_rule_history: null_as_unrewarded (the text-frozen 1.0 (iv) rule, design sha256 5e61c20b...) superseded for CH203 by amendment 13.7 (from LT7 13.7 and its erratum, LIVE_TESTS_7.md sha256 8fc83a73...); the v1 ft_both, VIF_w and slope MDE are reported as descriptive only

member_cap.rule: n_members(e, k) = distinct markets of Gamma event e among capture k's complete rows that are binary, open and active (an origin-side count, one-sided books included); a market without event_id is its own event with 1 member; CH203 and CH204 keep n_members <= 10 (the ladder arm, > 10, is reported, uncounted); CH202 keeps all event sizes

CH203.quiet_rule: |smid_{k-1} - smid_{k-2}| < 0.005 and |mid_k - smid_{k-1}| < 0.005 (strict; the comparison uses 0.005 - 1e-9 so that a half-tick change of exactly 0.005 is never quiet through float noise)
CH203.first_origin_rule: first capture whose pass k - 2 sweep starts at or after REGISTERED_UTC (12-30T04:31Z as proposed; the 00:31Z and 02:31Z origins are lt7_boundary)

CH202.first_origin_rule: first capture whose k - 1 capture and pass k - 1 sweep start at or after REGISTERED_UTC (12-30T02:31Z as proposed; the 00:31Z origin is lt7_boundary)

CH204.first_origin_rule: first capture at or after REGISTERED_UTC with 84 look-back (12-30T00:31Z as proposed)

seeds.derived_rule: size-check sub-seeds derived from 20261187 as in LT7 (phase 2)

gates.perm_method: block circular-shift Freedman-Lane for all three primaries (LIVE_TESTS_8.md 1.8)

inference.p_rule: p = max(p_event on t with G_event - 1 df, p_two-way normal, p_day on t with G_day - 1 df); CH202 and CH204 event df use min(G_event, G_minor) - 1

size_check.rule: phase 2; a failing binding scenario sets only its own tests to 'SE check failed' with k unchanged; world 12 and 3r never binding (R1 must-fix 6, re-check fix 1); world 8 reads p_vm = max(CS8 vol_missing share of CH203's primary units, 0.78)

census_inputs.lt8_seal_note: written by run_live_tests8.py seal after the design-text freeze; committed before any LT8 census
census_inputs.sweep_block_rule: an origin belongs to the block holding the slot of its latest required sweep (pass k - 1); from the seal's file list CH203 has 22 / 19 origins in A / B and CH202 24 / 21 (design 7)
census_inputs.covered_days_rule: covered origins / 12 (CS8: origins with the required sealed sweeps and captures; F pairs: origins whose lag sweeps k + 5, k + 6 are also sealed; CC8: origins with captures k - 1 and k sealed and at least 70 of the 84 changes observable from the sealed slots); below the minimum every gate of that test's census is NaN and fails; a sweep block below 12 origins likewise (the F pairs are not put under the per-block rule)
census_inputs.block_gate_share_proxy: ceil(16 x covered_days / 21) units of the test's population in the census days
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / covered days (an estimate); distinct events: events over the covered days x 21 / covered days (gated) and E_all + (E_all - E_day1) x (21 - covered_days) (printed)

lag_loader.ch204: reads sigma(k + 2) (a calendar fact) and nothing of capture k + 1 or k + 2

mde_common.rule: slope and class MDE gates: max(declared, design); declared = the closed formula at the census's own n_eff, DE_gate, VIF_w, tercile gap and the declared SD; design = 3.47 x 1.5 x SD x se_1 (x the tercile gap for a slope), se_1 = the standard error of the tested coefficient in the primary model on the census units' expanding-past-demeaned regressors under a working covariance (unit variance, within-event equicorrelation 0.02, independence across events), projected to 21 days with events recurring (counts and cluster sizes x 21 / covered days), no target read; F-MDE = max(declared form MDE x sqrt(2 / (1 - max(0, r_gate))), design-based MDE of Delta = beta(zdimb5) - beta(zdimb5_lag) in the arm model); NaN fails; DE_gate = max(floor, 1 + (m_21 - 1) x 0.02); the census takes t_sum = max(3.47, exact)
